title: record_outcome answer
description: The memory tool record_outcome's answer (SB-P5-11, migration 060): how a decision turned out, recorded as a change of its state, not its words. result right, wrong or mixed: it is asked about no more (review_at null, rearms 0); unknown: too early to tell, it comes up for review again 90 days on (rearms 1 or 2), and a third unknown stops the asking (reviews_done true, review_at null). previous is the outcome before (null: none yet). changed is ["outcome"]: the state before is kept as a version, the revision moved, history records it (outcome) and undo takes it back; or empty with unchanged true when it had that outcome already (or unknown had stopped the asking), and nothing was written. A write's fields otherwise: no memory's words, a project by id and slug only. Listed and answered only with memory.tools on (contracts/README.md 2.1). The JSON in its text content, and on success the same as its structured content; a refusal is isError true with the refusal body (held: a memory held for review; retracted: one marked wrong; invalid: a memory that is no decision).

reviews_done.description: unknown stopped the asking: it is asked about no more.
